### subscribe

Model: [`DocketAlertsCreate`](../../courtlistener/models/docket_alerts.py#L10)

Subscribe to a docket. If you already have an alert for it, the existing alert is returned with `"already_subscribed": True` and nothing is created; otherwise this calls `create(docket, alert_type=1)`.

```python
client.docket_alerts.subscribe(docket)
```

| Field | Type | Choices | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `docket` | integer | | The docket's ID. |

### unsubscribe

Source: [`DocketAlerts.unsubscribe`](../../courtlistener/sync_client/docket_alerts.py#L65)

Unsubscribe from a docket: finds your alert for it and deletes it. Raises `ValueError` if you have no alert for that docket.

```python
client.docket_alerts.unsubscribe(docket)
```
